postings.title: Animator
postings.description:
Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. 
 
This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. 


WHAT’S THE ROLE?
Are you passionate about crafting compelling character and creature animation that elevates gameplay? At Frontier, animation is at the heart of our storytelling. We’re looking for an experienced Animator to join our talented team and help bring our worlds to life.
*Please note that candidates invited to interview may be asked to complete a role-related assessment in their own timeas part of the selection process.Further details regarding the expected time commitment will be provided in advance. 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
- Create high-quality, expressive character and creature animations using Maya.

- Implement animations into our proprietary Cobra engine.

- Collaborate across disciplines including Character Art, Code, Design, and VFX.

- Take direction from the Lead Animator and Game Director to realise the creative vision.

- Contribute to a culture of feedback and continuous improvement.

- Solve production challenges with creativity and technical know-how.

- Maintain accurate task tracking and validate assets to minimise bugs.

- Provide feedback to external development partners when needed.

- Support junior team members and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING
- Proven experience producing high-quality animation assets.

- Strong proficiency in Maya’s character animation tools.

- Excellent understanding of body mechanics, posing, timing, and acting choices.

- Experience with creature animation and believable movement.

- Familiarity with animation state machines.

- Understanding of versioning software (SVN, Perforce).

- Strong time management and communication skills.

- Basic knowledge of rigging pipelines.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE
- Experience with external animation behaviour tree software (e.g. Havok, Unity, Unreal)

- Scripting knowledge (Python, MEL)

- Experience mentoring or training junior animators

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. 

Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.  

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events. 

We strive to create an environment where everyone can fully demonstrate their capability and potential. If you therefore need any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition representative.  

For queries, please email: recruitment@frontier.co.uk

postings.title: Experienced Character Artist
postings.description:

This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. 


WHAT’S THE ROLE?
The Experienced Character Artist will be responsible for delivering high-quality, game-ready character and creature assets, while also taking a proactive role in mentoring, problem-solving, and improving the wider team’s workflows and quality standards. 
This role will act as a key contributor and a point of support within the team, representing character art when required and supporting leads and production with planning, outsourcing feedback, and documentation. The Experienced Character Artist should consistently demonstrate artistic excellence, technical understanding, and leadership through collaboration.
 
*Please note that candidates invited to interview may be asked to complete a role-related assessment in their own timeas part of the selection process.Further details regarding the expected time commitment will be provided in advance. 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
- Create polished, optimised 3D character and creature assets from concept to implementation. 

- Demonstrate a proactive approach to responsibility, confidently taking ownership of work, driving outcomes, and contributing to team success with minimal supervision.

- Support and influence others through constructive feedback, collaboration, and cross-functional communication, acting as a positive role model regardless of prior leadership experience.

- Collaborate closely with leads and producers to understand project goals, schedules, and priorities. 

- Mentor and support junior character artists, helping to grow team skill and confidence. 

- Troubleshoot technical and artistic issues and share solutions with the wider team. 

- Drive improvements in workflows and contribute to maintaining or updating documentation. 

- Help write briefs and provide clear, actionable feedback to outsourcing vendors. 

- Maintain a neat, clear, and organised working practice to enable asset sharing and collaborative handovers.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING
- Experience delivering high-quality game-ready character/creature assets. 

- Expert knowledge of sculpting, modelling, topology, UVs, baking, texturing, and experience with checking assets into game-engine.

- Deep understanding of anatomy, proportion, form, deformation, and visual storytelling. 

- Strong proficiency with industry-standard tools: ZBrush, Maya, Substance Painter, Photoshop. 

- Comfortable debugging pipeline and software issues, suggesting workarounds and improvements, as well as actively seeking out solutions from technical specialists when necessary.

- Ability to work independently and proactively contribute to team-wide goals. 

- Experienced in giving and receiving feedback constructively, including mentoring and reviews. 

- Able to represent the team externally and support leads in managing planning and outsourcing. 

- Effective communication and collaboration across disciplines.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE
- Experience working on AAA titles or complex character systems. 

- Familiarity with cloth, hair, and rigging workflows, with an understanding of what is required from character assets to support those systems. 

- Experience creating or maintaining internal documentation. 

- Passion for creatures and anatomy.

- Well-rounded traditional art skills, for example an aptitude for 2D drawing

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. 

Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.  

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events.

Leading the delivery of scenery assets and set-based content across your team’s workstreams, ensuring output meets quality, performance, and schedule expectations.

Translating art direction into clear, actionable goals and supporting your team to deliver consistent, high-quality results.

Working closely with Production to plan work, provide estimates, track progress, and identify risks early.

Supporting your team day-to-day by reviewing work, providing clear feedback, and helping to resolve challenges to keep delivery moving.

Maintaining alignment with technical requirements, pipelines, and performance constraints.

- 

Assigning work effectively to balance delivery needs with individual development.

- 

Creating a positive, collaborative team environment where people feel supported and motivated.

- 

Acting as the main point of contact for scenery-related work, collaborating with Art Direction, Production, and other teams to keep everything aligned and moving forward.

- 

Contributing to team planning and resourcing, supporting improvements to workflows and processes, and working with external partners where required.

Strong experience delivering high-quality 3D assets within a game development environment.

Highly developed capability in asset creation workflows, including modelling, texturing, and real-time integration.

Solid hands-on experience with industry tools such as Maya, Substance Painter, and ZBrush.

- 

Experience leading or coordinating a team delivering content at scale.

- 

Experience line managing individuals, including performance reviews, goal setting, and development planning.

- 

A good understanding of production pipelines, scheduling, and working across disciplines.

- 

The ability to balance visual quality with performance and delivery constraints.

- 

Strong artistic judgement, including composition, scale, and visual storytelling.

- 

Clear communication, organisation, and decision-making skills.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE

Experience working with outsourcing teams and external partners.

- 

Experience supporting team planning or resourcing.

- 

Familiarity with modular workflows, kit building, or large asset libraries.

WHAT'S THE ROLE?
We are looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to join our Planet Coaster 2 team and play an important role in delivering quality experiences to our players. Joining an established and diverse team, you will bring experience, expertise, curiosity and energy to the development of our games.  You will program primarily in C++ working with our in-house Cobra engine and cross-platform game code.
As part of our development team, you will have a fantastic opportunity to apply, expand and share your expertise in modern game development techniques, and help push the boundaries of the current generation of gaming platforms. You will be collaborating with a talented team of programmers working on game features alongside specialists across multiple disciplines. You will also collaborate with game designers and QA testers on tuning the player experience.
This is an exciting opportunity to be part of the team behind our multi‑million‑selling, cross‑platform titles and help us continue delivering exceptional gaming experiences to our players.    


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Architecting and developing game features and systems.

- Collaborating effectively with team members and discipline leads.

- Designing and implementing technology using structured, efficient, maintainable, and well‑documented code. 

- Considering the impact of systems on other disciplines and projects, ensuring usability, scalability, and support for long-term maintenance.

- Guiding more junior programmers and providing feedback on their code, documentation and approach to game development.

- Creating and maintaining project wide documentation for more complex systems, features and workflows. 

- Participating in, contributing to, and occasionally leading aspects of project reviews and meetings, as required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
- A track record in the development of complex game features in released titles. 

- Excellent problem solving and programming skills using modern C++.

- Experience working in a large codebase with the ability to adapt to established methods.

- Proficient profiling and optimisation skills for CPU performance and memory usage.

- Experience of cross-discipline collaboration with game designers and content creators.

- A genuine passion for video games.

- A desire to be part of a world class team and contribute to its continued success.

- A proactive approach to collaborative learning and knowledge sharing with colleagues.

- A drive to expand your existing expertise in game development, and a passion for continued learning and self-improvement.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE
- Experience working with a proprietary game engine.

- Familiarity providing technical direction to teams for the development of core systems, game features or workstreams.

- Experience managing or mentoring other programmers to support their growth.

- Cross-platform development experience on shipped titles, including consoles (Xbox, PlayStation, etc.).

- Working knowledge of an entity component system.
